Package neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.propertygenerator

Class OlgaTableQualityReport

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.propertygenerator.OlgaTableQualityReport
public class OlgaTableQualityReport extends Object
Quality checks of a generated OLGA property table.

The report states whether OLGA can load the table (every value finite, densities and transport properties positive), counts monotonicity violations of density along pressure and of enthalpy and entropy along temperature, separately for nodes where the phase exists and for extrapolated nodes, and measures continuity across phase boundaries: the largest relative jump between neighbouring nodes where the phase existence changes, against the largest jump between neighbouring existing nodes. A boundary jump much larger than the interior jump marks a discontinuous extrapolation. Retrograde liquid density legitimately falls with pressure, so violations at existing nodes are reported, not treated as errors. writeCsv(String) exports every node for plotting.

1.0
